claims.text: An SPA report datelined Riyadh 10 Rajab 1436 / 29 April 2015 says that Prince Muqrin bin Abdulaziz pledged allegiance that evening, at Qasr al-Hukm in Riyadh, to Mohammed bin Nayef as Crown Prince and Mohammed bin Salman as Deputy Crown Prince, and that princes, the Grand Mufti, scholars, ministers, senior civil and military officials and large crowds of citizens also gave the pledge.
claims.uncertainty: A news-agency report of the evening ceremony, kept separate from the orders (A/159, A/160) and from the call. The release ends with 'to follow'; any continuation was not read.
